opportunities.name: Sephora Squad
opportunities.notes: Engagement over size; ~15 min app; have a headshot ready; answers can't be edited. Need an active IG or TikTok to apply.

opportunities.name: Skeepers Creators (formerly Octoly)
opportunities.follower_min: 1K subs + 2K avg views on last 5 videos
opportunities.what_you_get: Free full-size product from 300+ brands in exchange for honest review
opportunities.notes: Best YouTube-native fit. Pick products and post reviews; consistent posting keeps you in good standing.

opportunities.name: Picky Creators
opportunities.follower_min: none (Plus tier: 100K views on beauty videos)
opportunities.notes: Apply per campaign; keep product. Good for Shorts.

opportunities.name: ShopMy
opportunities.what_you_get: Brand gifting invites (Lookbooks) + 15-25% beauty commission; gifting requests at Trendsetter tier+
opportunities.notes: Brands browse your profile and send gifting invites. Put ShopMy links in YouTube descriptions.

opportunities.name: YouTube Shopping Affiliate
opportunities.notes: Threshold dropped from 10K to 500 subs in Mar 2026. Tag products in every review video.

opportunities.name: Collabstr
opportunities.what_you_get: Paid + gifted collabs; you list your rates
opportunities.notes: Create a YouTube package listing (e.g. dedicated review / integrated mention).

opportunities.name: Insense
opportunities.what_you_get: Gifted + paid UGC and creator briefs
opportunities.notes: Good for paid UGC; footage can double as YouTube B-roll if rights allow.

opportunities.name: Aspire
opportunities.what_you_get: Gifted + paid; many brands run affiliate via Aspire (e.g. Mario Badescu)
opportunities.notes: Join creator marketplace; also used by brand-specific programs below.

opportunities.name: Upfluence
opportunities.what_you_get: Gifting/affiliate via brand portals (Versed / innisfree run here)

opportunities.name: Ulta Beauty - UB Creates
opportunities.notes: Approval ~3-5 business days.

opportunities.name: Ulta Beauty Collective
opportunities.notes: Set a reminder for next summer (~June).

opportunities.name: Amazon Influencer Program
opportunities.what_you_get: Storefront commission + video reviews on product pages
opportunities.notes: No free product. Pair with Creator Connections campaigns inside the program.

opportunities.name: Amazon Vine
opportunities.notes: Can't apply. Invites go to people who write detailed and helpful reviews.

opportunities.name: Influenster (Bazaarvoice)
opportunities.notes: Complete "Snaps" surveys and keep profile + social links current. VoxBox unboxings work well as video content.

opportunities.name: BzzAgent
opportunities.what_you_get: Free campaign products (L'Oreal / Lancome / Armani seen)

opportunities.name: PINCHme
opportunities.what_you_get: Free sample boxes (Sample Tuesday at noon ET)
opportunities.notes: Samples mostly; good for "trying free samples" style videos.

opportunities.name: Hypely
opportunities.what_you_get: Products from brands like Drunk Elephant / MAC / Benefit

opportunities.name: Sampler
opportunities.what_you_get: Samples from Dove / Kiehl's / NYX / La Roche-Posay

opportunities.name: L'Oreal Consumer Testing
opportunities.what_you_get: Free products (at home or in person in NJ/OH/IL)
opportunities.notes: Testing usually comes with an NDA. Don't film unreleased products.

opportunities.name: No7 Volunteer Panel
opportunities.notes: NDA likely

opportunities.name: OSEA Malibu Affiliates
opportunities.notes: Post 2x/month.

opportunities.name: Curl Origin Ambassador
opportunities.notes: Curly/natural hair content only.

opportunities.name: Glossier (Generation Glossier)
opportunities.notes: No free product stated.

opportunities.name: Rare Beauty
opportunities.what_you_get: Gifting via direct outreach + tagged content; 7% affiliate
opportunities.notes: Tag consistently; pitch PR.

opportunities.name: Glow Recipe PR
opportunities.notes: Send media kit with YouTube stats.

opportunities.name: Make Up For Ever Backstage Pro
opportunities.notes: Apply when you reach 10K. Needs analytics screenshot + photo ID.

opportunities.name: NARS Pro
opportunities.notes: Creative-professional tier 30%. Needs proof of profession.

opportunities.name: MAC Pro
opportunities.notes: Only if makeup is your primary job.

opportunities.name: Rakuten
opportunities.what_you_get: Cash back at Sephora (up to ~18% on boosted days) and Ulta (~12% boosted)
opportunities.notes: Rates swing daily; buy on boosted days. Stack with retailer sales.

opportunities.name: Ibotta
opportunities.notes: Good for drugstore beauty at Target/Walmart.

opportunities.name: Fetch
opportunities.notes: Scan every haul receipt.

trends.description: Salmon DNA and other clinic ingredients are now in drugstore serums. This is the biggest K-beauty story of 2026.
Routines focus on the skin barrier and prevention more than fixing wrinkles.
Azelaic acid and hypochlorous acid are popular for redness and breakouts.
Jellies, whipped foams, capsules and 3D creams look good in close-up shots.
Products that cool the skin and calm redness.
Medicube AGE-R and LED masks. Long-term tests do well.
Velvety matte finishes that stay hydrated. Fenty, Rare and Drunk Elephant all launched foundations this fall.
Tints, CC creams and SPF makeup.
Diffused arches instead of laminated brows.
Many new brands are scalp-focused (BASE-K, Manuscript, TMPL8, Jupiter, Liva).
Skincare ingredients like cica, PDRN and peptides used on the scalp.
Plus magnetic cat-eye finishes and butter yellow.
Primers and layering products that make perfume last (Obart).
Contrapposto, An Ori, LeNose, Annual Leave, Reference and EAUSO VERT all launched this year.
